    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Activity
    Who is really playing: a player counts as active while they turned their view in the last Activity.AFK_MINUTES minutes.
    AdminLog
    What admins changed, so a server with several staff can see who made a change: one line per change in universe/mods/atomictempest/admin-log/<day>.log, with the time, who, the plugin and what changed.
    Announcements
    Notable moments worth telling people outside the game: a jackpot, a lottery winner, a big win, an achievement.
    Announcements.Listener
     
    BlockFacing
    Turns positions and directions given relative to a block's model into world space, following the way the block was rotated when placed.
    Boosters
    Personal boosters: one player's boost of one kind for a while ("+100% monster gold for 60 minutes"), given with /booster, so a crate prize, a quest or a vote reward can hand them out.
    Boosts
    Boosts for a while: more coins from monsters or ores, bigger quest and daily rewards, more battle pass XP, better shop prices.
    Boosts.Source
    Where boosts come from.
    CasinoSettings
    Registry of the tabs shown in the Tempest settings menu (/tempest).
    ChatPrefix
    The coloured tag in front of a mod's chat messages, such as "[Slots]", as the admin set it.
    CoinEffects
    Visual coin effects shared by the ATM and other mods.
    CoreAPI
    The version of Core's API, for plugins built on it.
    CraftRestrictions
    Items that only admins may craft unless a setting says otherwise.
    Currency
    The name of the money in every message, from the economy in use: Coins' names as the admin set them on its Currency tab, or the VaultUnlocked economy's own.
    Demand
    Items the server wants right now, so other plugins can reward the work that brings them in (API version 17).
    Demand.Source
    What one plugin wants now: item ids.
    Doctor
    The Tempest doctor (/tempest doctor, API 13): looks through every plugin's settings for ways players could make money from nothing, before they find them.
    Doctor.Check
    What a plugin tells the doctor.
    Doctor.Finding
    One thing the doctor found.
    Doctor.Findings
    Where a plugin writes what it found.
    Doctor.Level
    How bad a finding is.
    Doctor.Market
    Every place players buy and sell items, filled by the plugins on each check.
    Doctor.Price
    One place where players trade an item for coins.
    Doctor.Resale
    Buying an item and selling it back: kept is the share of the money that comes back (0 to 1).
    Economies
    Picks the economy the AtomicTempest plugins use: one a plugin registered (Coins does, when installed), otherwise the VaultUnlocked economy if there is one.
    Economy
    The server's money, whichever plugin keeps it.
    Editions
    Which edition of each plugin is running, for plugins that come as a free and a Pro jar.
    Editions.Edition
    One plugin's edition: what it is called, whether it is Pro, what Pro adds (shown in the free one), and who the Pro copy is licensed to ("" when unknown).
    HelpTopic
    One page of the help screen (/guide, and /coins when Coins is installed).
    HelpTopic.Action
    What a button does.
    HelpTopic.Button
    A button under the text, shown only to players the filter accepts.
    HelpTopics
    The pages of the help screen.
    HudLines
    Short lines of text shown under the coin counter in the corner of the screen.
    ItemIcons
    Item ids that are safe to draw.
    JsonFiles
    Settings and data kept as JSON files, saved with SafeFiles (a crash in the middle of a save leaves a whole copy).
    JsonFiles.Migration
    One step that brings a file's JSON from one config version to the next: renames or moves settings.
    Lang
    The language of the plugins' texts.
    Leaderboards
    Extra boards for the leaderboards screen (/leaderboards), added by other mods.
    Leaderboards.Board
     
    Levels
    Player levels from whichever leveling mod the server runs, as Economies is for money: one way for every Tempest plugin to read a player's level, give leveling XP and hear about level-ups, without depending on the mod.
    Levels.Leveling
    A leveling mod, as Tempest sees it.
    Levels.Listener
    Level-ups and prestige, from any leveling mod.
    Mailbox
    One mailbox for every Tempest plugin (Core API version 6).
    Mailbox.Claimed
    What a claim gave.
    Mailbox.Item
    Some of one item.
    Mailbox.ItemGiver
    Gives one kind of item; returns how many did not fit.
    Mailbox.Parcel
    One parcel: who it is from, its title, items and money.
    MapPlaces
    Places on the world map (API version 7).
    MapPlaces.Kind
    A kind of place.
    MapPlaces.Place
    One place.
    MapPlaces.Shown
    A place with everything that decides how it looks and who sees it.
    Perks
    Rank perks: bonuses for players who have a perk's permission.
    Perks.Bonus
    The bonuses a perk can give, each in percent.
    Placeholders
    Named values for each player, such as coins_balance or lottery_pot, for scoreboards, chat formats and placeholder plugins.
    PlayerActions
    Things players do in the economy mods, reported for other mods to count (the Quests mod builds its achievements and quests on them).
    PlayerActions.Listener
     
    PlayLimits
    A daily limit on what each player may stake in games of chance (Slots, Lottery, Coinflip and any game built on Core), set by the admin in /tempest (General, "Daily limit for games"; 0 = no limit).
    RateLimit
    Stops one player from flooding the server: an announcement, payment or message happens at most once in a while per key.
    Registrations
    Everything one plugin adds to Core, taken back with one call in shutdown().
    ReservedDrops
    Items dropped on the ground that only one player can pick up for a while, such as slot machine winnings.
    Rewards
    Rewards beyond money, the same in every Tempest plugin (Core API version 18): items and a server command.
    SafeFiles
    Saving that survives a crash or a power cut in the middle of a save.
    SafeFiles.Parser<T>
    Turns a file's text into something; may throw if the text is not what it should be.
    ServerInfo
    The server's own page: rules and server info the admin writes in /tempest (Server info tab).
    Setting
    One line of the Tempest settings menu: a number field, an on/off toggle, a text field, a colour picker, or a heading.
    Setting.Choice
    One entry of a dropdown: the value saved, and what the admin reads.
    Setting.Type
     
    SettingsTab
    One tab of the Tempest settings menu.
    Skills
    Skills from MMO Skill Tree (by Ziggfreed), when it runs: one level per skill (Mining, Swords, custom skills), skill XP, and what happens in it, for any plugin, without depending on the mod.
    Themes
    The look of every Tempest menu, chosen by the admin (/tempest, General, "Menu theme"): a preset or their own colours.
    Themes.Theme
    One theme.
    Unlocks
    Town unlocks: features a server can switch on as its town grows, such as savings interest once a bank is built.
    Unlocks.Feature
    A feature that can be locked until the town unlocks it.
    Unlocks.Listener
    Hears when a feature is switched on or off.
    Unlocks.Provider
    Decides which features are on.
    UpdateCheck
    Tells admins when a newer version of a Tempest plugin is out.
    UpdateCheck.Update
    A plugin with a newer version out.
    WalletEvents
    Tells other mods about every change to any wallet: who, how much, why and the balance after.
    WalletEvents.Listener
    One change of one wallet.
    WalletEvents.Veto
    Asked before coins leave a wallet.
    WhatsNew
    "What's new" for admins: after a Tempest plugin was updated, each admin is told once in chat, on their next join, which plugins changed and the first lines of their release notes.
    WhatsNew.Change
    One plugin that changed since an admin last joined.
